name: zendesk-admin
description: Zendesk administration: business-rule audits, backlog and SLA health, security review, and agent offboarding.
long_description: Twelve focused tools instead of a wrapper around the whole API. Reads are annotated readOnly; the two writes (reassign tickets, suspend or change a user's role) are disabled by default and run as a dry run unless explicitly told otherwise. The Zendesk role of the token remains the real security boundary.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Verify the connection and show which account and role the server operates as.

tools.name: audit_business_rules
tools.description: Triggers, automations and macros: finds inactive, unused, stale and duplicate rules.

tools.name: list_ticket_fields
tools.description: Inventory of ticket fields, flagging inactive and custom ones.

tools.name: list_sla_policies
tools.description: SLA policies with their targets by priority and metric.

tools.name: backlog_health
tools.description: Counts by status and priority, unassigned tickets, and the most stalled ones.

tools.name: agent_workload
tools.description: Distribution of open tickets per agent.

tools.name: security_overview
tools.description: Admins, unused OAuth tokens and installed apps.

tools.name: recent_admin_changes
tools.description: Configuration changes from the audit log. Requires the Enterprise plan.

tools.name: find_user
tools.description: Find users by name, email or Zendesk search syntax.

tools.name: offboarding_report
tools.description: Open tickets, groups and role for a departing agent. Read-only.

tools.name: reassign_tickets
tools.description: Reassign an agent's open tickets to another agent. Dry run by default.

tools.name: set_user_status
tools.description: Suspend, reactivate or change a user's role. Dry run by default.

subdomain.title: Zendesk subdomain
subdomain.description: Subdomain only. If you sign in at https://acme.zendesk.com, the value is: acme

email.title: Email of the API token owner
email.description: Leave empty if you are using an OAuth token.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Stored in the OS keychain, not in plain text. Zendesk has deprecated API tokens: prefer OAuth for shared use.

oauth_token.title: OAuth token (recommended alternative)
oauth_token.description: If set, this takes precedence over the API token.

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Enables reassign_tickets and set_user_status. Even when enabled, both run as a dry run until called with dry_run=false.
